U=U

An important fact

Undetectable = Untransmittable.

ART can reduce HIV in the blood to levels that standard viral load tests cannot detect. When a person is on effective treatment and maintains an undetectable viral load, they do not sexually transmit HIV to their partners.

U=U is not only important for prevention. Understanding the science can also challenge fear and reduce stigma.

Learn about U=U

Myths & Facts

Misinformation can create distance where none is needed.

Myth

HIV can be transmitted through hugging.

Fact

HIV is not transmitted through everyday social contact such as hugging or sharing food.

Why can this myth be harmful?

Misunderstanding transmission can cause people to be avoided or treated differently for no medical reason.

About Ruang Tanpa Stigma

HIV information should be understandable without making anyone feel judged.

Ruang Tanpa Stigma is a new digital health education initiative working to make HIV information easier to understand, more human, and more relevant to communities in Indonesia.
